name: Middenworm Infestation

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

disable: DC 23 Medicine check or DC 26 Thievery check to carefully cut into the corpse and vent the worms harmlessly in a safe direction

items.name: Worm Burst
items.text:
Trigger A creature jostles or touches the infested corpse

---
Effect The corpse bursts open, spraying hundreds of middenworm larvae in a 20-foot emanation. Creatures in the area must attempt a DC 25 Reflex save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Sickened 1 and takes 2d8 piercing damage from worm bites.

Failure The creature is sickened 1 and takes 4d8 piercing damage plus 2d6 persistent,piercing damage as the biting worms latch on.

Critical Failure As failure, but Sickened 2 and the persistent piercing damage increases to 4d6 persistent,piercing damage.

text: A dead body seems to ripple and bulge, as if something inside were shaking.
